content.title: Abyss Lateral Reveal | Foreground Chain, Depth Markers and Distant Citadel
content.summary: A lateral move reveals a subterranean archive across a reservoir chasm. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One continuous camera path reveals scale. + Foreground objects remain as registration anchors. + Scale references accumulate from near to far. + The destination structure appears only after depth is proven. + The final wide frame retains all major depth layers.
quick_start.recommended_input: Begin behind one black basalt rib and a suspended copper chain in a vast underground reservoir. Reveal three luminous water falls and two narrow service bridges as scale markers. Settle into a wide frame containing foreground chain, chasm, bridges, falls and the full citadel.
required_anchors: One continuous camera path reveals scale.
Foreground objects remain as registration anchors.
The destination structure appears only after depth is proven.
The final wide frame retains all major depth layers.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A lateral move reveals a subterranean archive across a reservoir chasm. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 用一次缓慢连续横移从近处岩壁和锁链进入广阔地下峡谷；熔岩瀑布、桥梁和远端蓝光城塞依次提供尺度参照，终局停在完整深渊地理。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One continuous camera path reveals scale.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One continuous camera path reveals scale."

invariants.rule: Foreground objects remain as registration anchors.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Foreground objects remain as registration anchors."

invariants.rule: Scale references accumulate from near to far.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Scale references accumulate from near to far."

invariants.rule: The destination structure appears only after depth is proven.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The destination structure appears only after depth is proven."

invariants.rule: The final wide frame retains all major depth layers.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final wide frame retains all major depth layers."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
